title: Microsoft-Managed SSL/TLS Certificates for Custom Domains Now Available in Power Pages
summary: We’re excited to announce that Microsoft-managed SSL/TLS certificates are now available for custom domains in Power Pages. When you connect a custom domain, you can now choose an SSL/TLS certificate that Microsoft provisions, configures, and renews for you.
body_markdown:
We’re excited to announce that Microsoft-managed SSL/TLS certificates are now available for custom domains in Power Pages.


When you connect a custom domain, you can now choose an SSL/TLS certificate that Microsoft provisions, configures, and renews for you. You do not need to purchase a certificate, upload a PFX file, or track the certificate’s renewal date. This option is now available in the ‘Connect Custom Domain’ wizard in the Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC).


## What’s new


- **Microsoft-managed certificates** are now available in the ‘ **Choose an SSL/TLS certificate** ‘ step in the ‘Connect Custom Domain’ wizard, alongside the options to upload a new certificate or use an existing one. Power Pages provisions the certificate for the host name you enter, and configuration typically completes in a few minutes.
- **Automatic certificate management** handles provisioning, configuration, and renewal, so you no longer need to track certificate expiry dates.
- **Support for existing custom domains:** Sites using an uploaded certificate can move to a Microsoft-managed certificate at any time.


## Why this matters


- **No certificate procurement** means you no longer need to buy a certificate, export it as a password-protected PFX file with the required encryption and key length, and upload it to Power Pages.
- **Lower risk of expired certificates** helps avoid browser warnings on live, customer-facing sites through automatic renewal.
- **Faster custom domain setup** lets you connect a domain in the admin center without completing a separate certificate procurement and upload process.
- **Continued certificate choice** preserves support for bring-your-own certificates. Existing sites are not migrated automatically and continue to operate without any impact.


## How to get started


Step 1: In the Power Platform admin center, go to Manage > Power Pages. Select your site, select Manage, and then select Connect Custom Domain in Site Details section.


Step 2: Select Add Microsoft Managed certificate, and then select Next.


Step 3: Enter the host name, validate the domain, review and finish. Configuration can take a few minutes.


**How to migrate to Microsoft-managed SSL/TLS certificate**


If you want to migrate to Microsoft-managed SSL/TLS certificates for an existing custom domain, remove the current SSL binding and certificate, then reconnect the domain by selecting ‘Add Microsoft Managed certificate’.
